feedback_by_option.fil: Gumagalaw pa ang trapiko. Malalagay rin sa panganib si Lea; tingnan muna ang panganib bago lumapit.
feedback_by_option.en: Traffic is still moving. Stepping in first puts Lea at risk too; look for hazards before approaching.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Inuuna ni Lea ang panganib, at agad tatawag ang saksi sa kumpirmadong emergency contact.
feedback_by_option.en: Right. Lea looks for hazards first, and the bystander activates the confirmed emergency route without delay.

feedback_by_option.fil: Naaantala ng mahabang history ang tawag. Iulat ang nakikita ngayon; makapaghihintay ang kuwento.
feedback_by_option.en: A full history delays the call. Report what you can see now; the story can wait.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Ang lokasyon at ang nakitang tugon at paghinga ang maikling ulat na kailangan ng sanay na tulong.
feedback_by_option.en: Right. Location plus the observed response and breathing is the concise report trained help needs.

feedback_by_option.fil: Iulat ang nakita, hindi ang hula. Ang sanay na tulong ang susuri.
feedback_by_option.en: Report observed facts, not guesses. Trained help does the assessment.

feedback_by_option.fil: Gamitin ang lokal na kumpirmadong contact. Huwag itong palitan ng national number.
feedback_by_option.en: Use the locally verified contact. Do not assume a national number replaces it.
